column3: Close to the Hebrew.
Close to the Hebrew.
The Hebrew says the heifer has not “drawn with a yoke”; BSB says it has never “been yoked.”
Close to the Hebrew.
The Hebrew explicitly repeats the LORD’s name and says every dispute and blow will be “by their mouth”; BSB uses “His name” and “give a ruling.”
Close to the Hebrew.
The Hebrew has both “answer” and “say” and does not explicitly include an object after “our eyes did not see”; BSB gives “declare” and supplies “it.”
The Hebrew directly asks for atonement and repeats “Your people Israel”; BSB has “Accept this atonement” and uses “them” for the second reference to Israel.
The Hebrew names “innocent blood” without the added wording “the guilt of shedding,” and says “you will do”; BSB supplies those words and says “you have done.”
The Hebrew shifts from plural “your enemies” to singular “him” and “his captivity”; BSB continues with plural “them.”
The Hebrew says to take her as a wife without an explicit verb “want”; BSB says “want to take her.”
The Hebrew says she is to “do” her nails; BSB specifies trimming them.
The Hebrew says to “come in to her”; BSB expresses this as having relations with her.
The Hebrew says to release her “to her soul”; BSB expresses this as letting her go “wherever she wishes.”
The Hebrew repeats “the loved and the hated” as the women bearing sons; BSB uses “both” and renders “hated” as “unloved.”
The Hebrew explicitly repeats “the firstborn” after naming the unloved woman’s son; BSB names him as firstborn only in the preceding clause about the beloved woman’s son.
Close to the Hebrew.
The Hebrew explicitly names the father’s and mother’s “voice” and actively says they discipline him; BSB has “obey his father and mother” and the passive “when disciplined.”
Close to the Hebrew.
The Hebrew repeats “of his city” with the elders and names “our voice”; BSB omits the city phrase here and says “does not obey us.”
Close to the Hebrew.
The Hebrew refers to hanging “him”; BSB makes “his body” explicit.
The Hebrew does not repeat “on a tree” in the curse clause; BSB supplies this phrase there.
